senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) help; trnsf. (after Gen. II, 20) helpmate.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 12:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XII</cite> <he>ועשאה ע׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>ועשתה</he>) and he made her a help and placed her opposite him.
Ib. משבנה לו ע׳ אשה when he had built for him a helpmate named ishshah.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 12:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אם זכה תהיה לו ע׳ וכ׳</he> if he deserves well, she will be to him a help, if not, an opposition; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:4">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00119"><he>נֶגֶד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:1">Yalk. Gen. 62</cite> <he>לאדם ולעֶזְרוֹ</he> for Adam and his wife; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 20">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XX</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 20">Ib.</cite> ch. XXI <he>אדם ועוזרו</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.
